description: This file declares the 'Clearcut' class which provides static methods for sending various device event metrics such as VM start, VM stop, device boot, and lock screen events within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes external proto definitions and is part of the metrics command module.

classes.name: Clearcut
classes.description: A class providing static methods to send device event metrics such as VM start, VM stop, device boot, and lock screen events.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Private static method to send a generic event with specified device and event types.

methods.name: SendVMStart
methods.description: Public static method to send a VM start event.

methods.name: SendVMStop
methods.description: Public static method to send a VM stop event.

methods.name: SendDeviceBoot
methods.description: Public static method to send a device boot event.

methods.name: SendLockScreen
methods.description: Public static method to send a lock screen event.
